$comment: The email binding's messages at envelope version 1, for a document without PGP, frozen (SPECIFICATION.md §13.4): what the bridge hands its mail library when it starts a thread (the invitation) and when it sends a frame, and how it reads a frame's body back. The PGP-signed and -encrypted form wraps the same envelope; its bytes depend on keys and are covered by the PGP tests. Checked by bridges/email-bridge/src/message.wire.test.ts against wire/wire-lock.json. Within a version an entry may be added, never changed or removed.
